question: How is Dhanpat Rai Srivastava better known as?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Premchand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dhanpat Rai Srivastava** is better known as **Munshi Premchand**.
 
• He is an **Indian author **of **novels **and **short stories **in **Hindi **and **Urdu **who pioneered in adapting Indian themes to Western literary styles.
 
• He began his career under the pen name "Nawab Rai"(Later switched to Munshi Premchand).
 
• He was influenced by the teachings of Swami Vivekananda.
 
• He was elected as the first President of the Progressive Writers' Association in Lucknow, in 1936.
 
• Notable works: Godaan, Karmabhoomi, Gaban, Mansarovar, Idgah.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ramdhari Singh** was famously known as **Dinkar**.

 
 
• He was an** Indian Hindi poet, essayist, patriot, and academic**.
 
• He has been hailed as a **Rashtrakavi** ('national poet') on account of his inspiring patriotic compositions.
 
• His works are mostly of** Veer Rasa**, or the 'brave mode', although Urvashi is an exception to this.
 
• Some of his greatest works are **Rashmirathi **and **Parashuram ki Prateeksha**.
 
 
 
• **Suryakant Tripathi** is famously known as **Nirala**.
 
 
• He was an **Indian poet, novelist, essayist, and story-writer who wrote in Hindi**.
 
 
 
• **Sachchidananda Hirananda Vatsyayan** is popularly known as **Agyeya**.
 
 
• He was an **Indian writer, poet, novelist, literary critic, journalist, translator,** and revolutionary in the Hindi language.
